quotes.speaker: Ryan Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Dunn on team chemistry and offensive movement
quotes.excerpt: Just mix up the game. In that unit we all have our strengths and weaknesses.
quotes.quote: Just mix up the game. In that unit we all have our strengths and weaknesses that we are trying to pose on each other and pose on defense. Offensively, just keep moving it, keep moving off the ball, cutting, and offensive rebounding. Defensively, if we are going small, just trying to use our speed and athleticism against the bigs. And then if we are going with O-So in the back up, just trying to be physical as a guard and then just making stuff happen on the team.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Dunn on the Suns small-ball strategy: We are just trying to use our speed and athleticism against the bigs and keep moving off the ball to create opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Dunn
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Dunn on his development since college
quotes.excerpt: It is cool because I feel I can go back to that and just know what I did.
quotes.quote: Since college, since at Virginia. I bet myself doing jump balls and tips and everything like that. It is cool because I feel I can go back to that and just know what I did out there. Trying to apply it here and just learn. We have a league-great bigs here, so I am learning from O-So as well. We kind of have the same physical attributes, our speed and our athleticism, so trying to figure out what he does to get us involved and then just taking my time when I get the ball.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Dunn says he is leaning on his experience from Virginia to adjust to the NBA game: I bet myself doing jump balls and tips and everything like that. It is cool because I feel I can go back to that.

quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Dunn on defending Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: It is tough because like you said, he is a giant and he is special and he is gifted.
quotes.quote: It is tough because like you said, he is a giant and he is special and he is gifted and he is a one-of-one player. So the biggest thing like we can do is just make it tough on him as much as I can.
